text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.734.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
GBrain memory is installed and connected to this agent with no API keys. Remember and recall worked with real GBrain calls, but I haven't tested recall in a new OpenClaw conversation yet.

**What was installed**
- **GBrain v0.60.734.0**, installed from `github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0` in place of `#stable`. Bun 1.4.4 was installed with it, and I added Bun to the command path in `~/.profile`.
- **Brain:** a local database at `/harness-state/.gbrain/brain.pglite`, set up keyword-only. No embedding, reranker or chat key is set, so nothing is sent to an outside provider.
- **Connection to OpenClaw:** gbrain is registered as an MCP server in `/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`, using the full path to the program and `serve --surface starter --advertise verbs`. OpenClaw's own check found 8 tools.
- **Brain-first rule:** `gbrain setup openclaw` added this rule two ways. It wrote a marked block to a new `/workspace/AGENTS.md` (you had none), and installed a small `gbrain-turn-rule` plugin that adds the rule next to every turn.

**Your identity and instructions are unchanged.** I didn't create or rewrite any SOUL or IDENTITY files, and your model and workspace settings are the same. The only config changes are the new `mcp.servers.gbrain` and `plugins.*gbrain-turn-rule` entries. One side effect: OpenClaw's save removed the comments from `openclaw.json`. The original is backed up at `/tmp/openclaw.json.bak`.

**Remember/recall test (all passed)**
1. **Command line:** I saved an install-check marker (fact #1), then recalled it with an exact keyword match.
2. **MCP:** I started the exact server command OpenClaw uses. A `remember` call saved a generic test note containing the codeword `heliotrope-7342` (fact #2), and `recall` returned it.
3. **Separate process:** a fresh server process recalled fact #2, and a command-line `gbrain search "heliotrope-7342"` found it by exact keyword.

**Things to know**
- **The gbrain tools aren't available in this conversation.** It started before I registered the server. A new session will load them.
- **Setup reported an error that is a false alarm.** `gbrain setup openclaw` exits with `turn_hook_not_loaded` because its check runs `openclaw` without your `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` and `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH` settings. It therefore looks in `~/.openclaw` and finds nothing. Running `openclaw plugins inspect gbrain-turn-rule --runtime --json` with your normal settings shows the plugin loaded with `before_prompt_build`, and `gbrain doctor` reports the hook as wired.
- **Last test step (yours):** start a new session and ask me to recall "gbrain install check". If that works, have me `forget` both test facts.

**Search mode (choose any time).** Conservative is in effect: gbrain picked it because there's no chat key or reranker.
```
Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.
```
1. **Conservative (active):** 4K-token budget, at most 10 chunks, no reranker. Best for cheap subagents and high-volume use.
2. **Balanced:** 12K budget, 25 chunks, reranked. Reranking needs a provider key.
3. **Tokenmax:** no budget, 50 chunks, reranked. It's the recommended mode once a chat key is set.

To switch, run `gbrain config set search.mode <mode>`. No mode expands queries by default.

**Other settings in effect (change any time)**
- **Automatic saving:** off, so I only save what you ask me to remember. `salient` is recommended for a personal brain; turn it on with `gbrain config set memory.auto_writeback salient`.
- **Upkeep:** a free maintenance pass runs while a gbrain session is open. Turn it off with `gbrain config set maintenance.auto false`.
- **Conversation archive:** on. It keeps one redacted page per conversation per day and nothing leaves this machine. Turn it off with `gbrain transcripts archive off`.
- **Not set up:** API keys, automatic capture, scheduled jobs, extra skills, a new agent identity and a private repo. Each is a separate opt-in.

If you'd rather not run anything locally, there is also a hosted version at gbrain.io.
